main_text.p: v. & Almawakef.converti aliquando possit in virum, aliquando in bestiam. Ut talem (ni fallor) tractare eum voluit Al-Walid undecimus e familia Bani ommia Chalifa, cum eum sagittis quas manu tenebat flagellare non desiit usque dum penitus lacerâsset, non aliam ob causam quam quod apertolibro in haec statim verba incidisset, وخاب كل جبار عنيد Damnum autem patietur omnis rebellis perversus, hoc illi subinde accinens.
اقوعن كل جبار عنيد فيها اناذا ك جبار عنيد [?]

إذا لاقيت ربك يوم حشر فقل ياربي مزقني الوالين [?]
i. e. Num increpas omnem rebellem perversum?

p.i: Ecce ego sum iste rebellis perversus.
Ubi occurreris domino tuo die judicii,
Dicas, O Domine, laceravit me, AlWalid.

main_text.p: referente Al Jannabio in vita AlWalidi.

Motazalii contrarii sunt Sephatii qui statuunt in Deo attributa aeterna, &c.] Mohammedanorum l. 8.antiquorum plerique attributa æterna Deo competere statuebant, teste AlSbareftanio, scientiæ, potentiæ, vitæ, &c. nullam adhuc agnoscentes distinctionem inter صفات الذات Attributa essentialia, & صفات الفعل Attributa Operationis, seu ab operibus defumpta, sed eodem modo de utrisque loquebantur. c. de AlSephatius.Statuebant insuper aliam speciem quam صفات خبرية Attributa declarativa seu narrationi inservientia nuncupabant; qualia, Manus facies, &c. quorum nullam explicationem seu interpretationem adhibebant. tantum dicebant قن ورفت في الشرع alata sunt hæc in lege, nosque ea attributa declarativa nuncupamus, quare cum postea negarent Al Motazali attributa ista, obtinuit ut illi صفاتيى Sephatii, i.e. Attributorum

page.notes: Arabic passages copied from a small, slightly blurred scan; the second and third Arabic lines and the Arabic in the Sephatii sentence are uncertain and marked [?] where doubtful. The word "Motazalii" at the start of the Sephatii paragraph is uncertain. The "illi" Arabic word before "Sephatii" appears garbled in the scan. Marginal notes are placed beside their approximate lines. Printing errors such as "apertolibro" (missing space) and "lacerâsset" are left as printed. The trailing "Gg" at the foot is a gathering signature, and "tributorum" is the catchword at the lower right.
